scientific_integrity: The analytic imaginary-axis exclusion and root-continuity argument proves the all-parameter claim; exact-arithmetic computational tests are corroborative only. No assertion of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite iid binary samples with strictly positive symbol probabilities; open-chain count of adjacent changes, not success-runs conditional on composition. Existence of independent quadratic-factor summands is distributional, not a coupling. General finite-sample proof given; classical spin-chain literature may contain an equivalent formulation.
title: Sharp degree-two convolution factorization for biased binary transition counts
